color.$description: Light theme surface, text, state and status colours. Values lifted verbatim from port-manifest/06-ui-behaviour.md §8.2, with the AA-corrected foreground variants from §8.3.

panel.$description: Chrome surface: sidebar, title bar, tab bar, popup container.

elevated.$description: Inset control surface: fields, chips, kbd, badges, empty-state icon.

raised.$description: Raised control surface: segmented-control on-state, secondary button hover.

raised-2.$description: Highest neutral surface: toggle off track, scrollbar thumb, spinner track.

dim.$description: Secondary text; ghost button rest state.

faint.$description: Tertiary text: placeholders, field icons, counts.

hover.$description: Neutral hover state layer over any surface.

selected.$description: Accent-tinted selection fill. Light uses 12%, not dark's 16%. CSS-only; Compose uses accent.copy(alpha = alpha-selected).

ok-strong.$description: AA-corrected foreground variant of --ok on its 12% tint (verified badge). §8.3 — do NOT merge into --ok.

warn-strong.$description: AA-corrected foreground variant of --warn (warn field notes, warn banners). §8.3.

err-strong.$description: AA-corrected foreground variant of --err on its 9%/16% tint (.btn--danger label). §8.3.

info-strong.$description: AA-corrected foreground variant of --info on its 12% tint (log level badge). §8.3.

c-unknown.$description: ADDED (not in the v1 dump). §8.7 closes the kind set with `unknown`; falls back to the text-kind colour.
